causal_hypothesis: Formatting the already-computed byte sum with awk printf %.0f will preserve exact integer text and pass the intended identity gate without changing checkpoint bytes or any scientific variable.

unchanged_controls: Same retained instance, derived image, verified checkpoint, tokenizer, quality suite, server command, semantic gate, paired quality gate, c1/c8 workloads, SLOs, economics, telemetry, timeout, and artifact contract as V18.

artifact_contract: Retrieve and hash the changed rerun archive before deleting the instance and disk; preserve the first failure archive separately.
